subject.title: Per-account native command prefix for multi-agent slash commands

question: Should Slack multi-account native slash commands be solved with validated account-level nativeNames mapping, constrained nativePrefix sugar, or documented as unsupported for duplicate native command names?
rationale: The fix adds a user-visible Slack account config/API surface and the closed implementation attempts show a real design fork that automation should not choose by itself.

options.title: Implement explicit nativeNames
options.body: Add validated per-account command-key to native-name mapping with duplicate/format checks, registration, dispatch, docs, and Slack native command tests.

options.title: Implement constrained nativePrefix
options.body: Add prefix sugar only with strict lowercase slug validation and no broad fallback stripping if maintainers prefer the simpler operator UX.

options.title: Document unsupported duplicates
options.body: Leave runtime unchanged and document that multiple Slack apps in one workspace must not register identical native command names.

recommendation.title: Implement explicit nativeNames
recommendation.body: Add validated per-account command-key to native-name mapping with duplicate/format checks, registration, dispatch, docs, and Slack native command tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history trail for Slack native command and shared registry behavior points to this owner candidate.
